meta.name: abp-development-flow
meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) development flow quick reference: adding an entity end-to-end (Domain→Shared→repo→EF config→migration→Contracts/DTO→mapping→app service→localization→permission→test). Use when you need the flow for adding a new feature in ABP.

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能指导你按照ABP Framework v10.x的标准步骤，从Domain层开始，依次添加实体、配置EF Core、创建DTO、编写应用服务、设置权限和测试，最终完成一个新功能的开发流程。
howto.when: 当你说出“ABP add new entity/feature”、“end-to-end CRUD”、“development flow”、“how do I start”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我要在ABP中添加一个新实体Book。
say.note: Claude会提供从Domain到测试的完整步骤。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to guide you through the ABP Framework v10.x standard steps for adding a new entity end-to-end: from Domain layer, EF Core configuration, migration, DTO creation, app service, localization, permission, to testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "ABP add new entity/feature", "end-to-end CRUD", "development flow", "how do I start".

say_en.text: I want to add a new entity Book in ABP.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the full flow from Domain to test.

say_en.text: How to add a DTO in ABP development flow?
say_en.note: Claude will guide on creating DTO and interface in Application.Contracts.

say_en.text: Give me the checklist for adding an entity in ABP.
say_en.note: Claude will list steps: Entity→Shared→... etc.
